description:
Create a new file, creating parent directories as needed. Existing paths are rejected; use edit to change an existing file.

In a registered writable knowledge directory, create `.md` documents or `.csv` tables. For `.md`, provide Markdown body content only; Locus generates frontmatter and reports every generated field plus the final content start line. For `.csv`, provide raw CSV content without Markdown fences or YAML frontmatter; content starts at physical line 1. CSV is supported in Design, Memory, Reference, and plan/ directories, not as an executable Skill. Both formats update the knowledge index and can be searched with `knowledge_query`.

filePath.description: Absolute or relative path to the file to write

content.description: The full file content. For registered knowledge documents: Markdown body only for `.md`, or raw CSV content for `.csv`.
